source: Measured natively, outside the engine, and to be re-measured through `ale validate` before the task is submitted: the reference controller (solution/reference: privileged tips in place of perception, rate commands through the public wire) played the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/procedures.json: 12 procedures x 800 steps, generator endosim-procedure/0.2) through tests/verify.py's own loop (tests/review/run_native.py: the same sessions, probes, budgets, renderer and canary; the controller and the renderer started as the calling account instead of through runuser), Isaac Sim 6.2.0.0 rendering on an NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada (not a cloud-listed GPU model), driver 570.195.03, no Docker. THE VALUE IS THE RUN OF 2026-11-25 ON THE TREE OF 763919b, whose probe copy is a possible observation (the frame rendered again with the instruments moved differently over its last step, the joints unchanged): useful_view_fraction 0.9030208 (8669 of 9600 steps; per procedure 0.939 0.865 0.953 0.925 0.876 0.914 0.838 0.934 0.874 0.928 0.926 0.866), probe pairs 163 of 589 differing (the lock's fraction is 0.1), no aborted procedure, no lens contact, 1922 s. The reference reads the simulator's state and never the picture, so the value does not depend on the renderer, but it depends a little on which steps are probed (the memory it keeps after a repeated step is the copy's about one time in ten): over ten draws of the probes the render-free loop (tests/review/fast_eval.py's sessions) gave 0.9029 to 0.9037. Before 763919b the copy was the frame shifted in the image with offset joint readings, which the reference never kept, and three runs and a fourth on 0d27fe0 gave 0.9034375 each. full_at 0.98: the spread over probe draws is below 0.1 %; the margin also covers a threshold flipped by rounding on another CPU (the numerics are not pinned). Status and what was not verified: tests/README.md section 7.
